verdict.rationale: Harbor Compliance documents electronic receipt of service-of-process and legal documents through its registered-agent service. Its public OpenAPI spec exposes registered-agent-deliveries endpoints, which implies received deliveries stay queryable in the account after notification. Records Manager (corporate-record storage) and annual-report document visibility are adjacent features and earn no credit here. Missing for 10: an explicit statement that received notices are archived in the account, documented retention duration or months-later retrieval, UI-level document history or search for received notices, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
